title: The Heart
label: ch:ka-heart
canDo: I can name my heart in Kannada and say why it is a genuine Indo-European cousin of the English word, not just a resemblance.

payoff.summary: Say ನನ್ನ ಹೃದಯ, read the vocalic-r sign ೃ against Chapter 14's independent ಋ, and trace hṛdaya to the same Proto-Indo-European root as English heart, Latin cor and Greek kardía.
